theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.measuredLeft_eq_trace
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem measuredLeft_eq_trace {n : ℕ} (plan : Plan n) (A B : Square n) :
    (∑ h : Fin plan.selected.length,
      dot (A.transpose *ᵥ uColumn plan h) (B.transpose *ᵥ uColumn plan h)) =
      (((B.transpose * planFrame plan).transpose) * (A.transpose * planFrame plan)).trace

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.measuredLeft_inner_selected
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem measuredLeft_inner_selected {n : ℕ} (plan : Plan n) (A B : Square n) :
    (∑ h : Fin plan.selected.length,
      dot (A.transpose *ᵥ uColumn plan h) (B.transpose *ᵥ uColumn plan h)) =
      NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner A (selectedProjection plan * B)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.measuredLeft_inner_projection
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem measuredLeft_inner_projection {n : ℕ} (plan : Plan n)
    (hF : (planFrame plan).transpose * planFrame plan = 1) (A B : Square n) :
    (∑ h : Fin plan.selected.length,
      dot (A.transpose *ᵥ uColumn plan h) (B.transpose *ᵥ uColumn plan h)) =
      NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner (selectedProjection plan * A)
        (selectedProjection plan * B)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.dot_mulVec_quadratic
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem dot_mulVec_quadratic {n : ℕ} (A B : Square n) (g : Fin n → ℝ) :
    dot (A *ᵥ g) (B *ᵥ g) = dot g ((A.transpose * B) *ᵥ g)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.dot_quadratic_eq_sum
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem dot_quadratic_eq_sum {n : ℕ} (M : Square n) (g : Fin n → ℝ) :
    dot g (M *ᵥ g) = ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, M i j * g i * g j

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.makePlan_residualProjection_eq
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem makePlan_residualProjection_eq {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (ξ : ℝ)
    (ω ω' : ℕ → ℝ) (copy copy' : Fin 15) :
    residualProjection (makePlan P ξ ω copy) = residualProjection (makePlan P ξ ω' copy')

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.makePlan_offsetQuadraticMatrix_eq
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem makePlan_offsetQuadraticMatrix_eq {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (ξ : ℝ)
    (ω ω' : ℕ → ℝ) (copy copy' : Fin 15) (R : Square n) (j : Fin (q + 1)) :
    offsetQuadraticMatrix P (makePlan P ξ ω copy) R j =
      offsetQuadraticMatrix P (makePlan P ξ ω' copy') R j

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.offsetQuadraticMatrix_trace
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem offsetQuadraticMatrix_trace {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (R : Square n) (j : Fin (q + 1)) :
    (offsetQuadraticMatrix P plan R j).trace =
      NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner (residualBasisBlock P plan j)
        (residualProjection plan * R)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.actualResidualOffset_centered_unscaled
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem actualResidualOffset_centered_unscaled {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (ξ : ℝ) (ω : ℕ → ℝ) (copy : Fin 15) (R : Square n) (j : Fin (q + 1))
    (hOrth : NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner (orthonormalMember P j) R = 0) :
    regressionOffset (orthonormalMember P) (makePlan P ξ ω copy) R j =
      (1 / ((makePlan P ξ ω copy).s : ℝ)) *
        (∑ g : Fin (makePlan P ξ ω copy).s,
          dot (fun k => (makePlan P ξ ω copy).G k g)
            (offsetQuadraticMatrix P (makePlan P ξ ω copy) R j *ᵥ
              (fun k => (makePlan P ξ ω copy).G k g))) -
        (offsetQuadraticMatrix P (makePlan P ξ ω copy) R j).trace

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.gaussianWidth_positive
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem gaussianWidth_positive (q : ℕ) (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    0 < gaussianWidth q ξ

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.actualResidualOffset_centered
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem actualResidualOffset_centered {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (ω : ℕ → ℝ) (copy : Fin 15) (R : Square n)
    (j : Fin (q + 1))
    (hOrth : NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner (orthonormalMember P j) R = 0) :
    regressionOffset (orthonormalMember P) (makePlan P ξ ω copy) R j =
      (1 / ((makePlan P ξ ω copy).s : ℝ)) *
        ∑ g : Fin (makePlan P ξ ω copy).s,
          (dot (fun k => (makePlan P ξ ω copy).G k g)
            (offsetQuadraticMatrix P (makePlan P ξ ω copy) R j *ᵥ
              (fun k => (makePlan P ξ ω copy).G k g)) -
            (offsetQuadraticMatrix P (makePlan P ξ ω copy) R j).trace)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.actual_offsetQuadratic_drop_projection
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem actual_offsetQuadratic_drop_projection {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (ξ : ℝ) (ω : ℕ → ℝ) (copy : Fin 15) (R : Square n) (j : Fin (q + 1)) :
    offsetQuadraticMatrix P (makePlan P ξ ω copy) R j =
      (residualBasisBlock P (makePlan P ξ ω copy) j).transpose * R

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.family_transpose_product_energy
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem family_transpose_product_energy {n q : ℕ} (F : Basis n q) (R : Square n) :
    (∑ j : Fin (q + 1), NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner
      ((F j).transpose * R) ((F j).transpose * R)) =
      (R.transpose * (∑ j : Fin (q + 1), F j * (F j).transpose) * R).trace

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.scalar_psd_trace_bound
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem scalar_psd_trace_bound {n : ℕ} (S R : Square n) (t : ℝ)
    (hS : (t • (1 : Square n) - S).PosSemidef) :
    (R.transpose * S * R).trace ≤ t * NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner R R

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.actual_offsetQuadratic_energy_contraction
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem actual_offsetQuadratic_energy_contraction {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (ξ : ℝ) (ω : ℕ → ℝ) (copy : Fin 15) (R : Square n) :
    (∑ j : Fin (q + 1), NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner
      (offsetQuadraticMatrix P (makePlan P ξ ω copy) R j)
      (offsetQuadraticMatrix P (makePlan P ξ ω copy) R j)) ≤
      threshold q ξ * NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner R R

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.actual_offsetQuadratic_varianceCharge
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem actual_offsetQuadratic_varianceCharge {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (ξ : ℝ) (ω : ℕ → ℝ) (copy : Fin 15) (R : Square n) :
    (∑ j : Fin (q + 1), 2 *
      (offsetQuadraticMatrix P (makePlan P ξ ω copy) R j *
        (offsetQuadraticMatrix P (makePlan P ξ ω copy) R j).transpose).trace) ≤
      2 * threshold q ξ * NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner R R
